input.code:
def process(noaaWildfires) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

    df = noaaWildfires.copy()

    # Parse start_date (m/d/YYYY) and keep Jan/Feb/Mar
    start = pd.to_datetime(df['start_date'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[start.dt.month.isin([1, 2, 3])].copy()

    # Keep only known causes: exclude 'U' (Unknown) and nulls
    df = df[df['cause'].notna() & (df['cause'] != 'U')].copy()

    # Contingency table: region x cause
    ct = pd.crosstab(df['region'], df['cause'])

    chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(ct)

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'chi2': float(chi2),
        'pValue': float(p),
        'dof': int(dof),
        'nFires': int(df.shape[0]),
        'nRegions': int(ct.shape[0]),
        'nCauses': int(ct.shape[1])
    }])
